title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Role - Senior Software Engineer

Location - Mumbai, Maharashtra

**About the Role**

Join an Engineering company as a SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER in Mumbai, where you will be part of a dynamic team working on a cutting-edge digital personal loan application. With a focus on innovation, compliance, and rapid scaling, this role offers significant opportunities for personal and professional growth. Contribute to impactful projects that facilitate seamless user experiences while collaborating with a talented group of engineers dedicated to excellence.

*An Engineering company operating in the technology sector, located in Mumbai, and focused on digital financial solutions.*

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and enhance production systems that handle high traffic and business-critical workloads.
* Design scalable, resilient, and maintainable systems, clearly articulating architectural boundaries and data flow.
* Write efficient production code in Python and Django, including API development and database migrations.
* Resolve production issues effectively while taking ownership of the systems you build.
* Deploy and manage cloud services on AWS, ensuring safe releases and proper configuration.
* Optimize SQL and NoSQL databases to ensure robust performance under growing data volumes.
* Build and maintain performant APIs, ensuring backward compatibility and observability.
* Utilize AI tools to improve engineering productivity through coding and testing enhancements.

**What We're Looking For**

* A minimum of 5 years of experience in software development and production delivery.
* Proficient in Python and Django with a strong background in API and database design.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, including service management and deployment strategies.
* Strong understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, including query optimization and indexing.
* Demonstrated ability to debug production issues and optimize existing systems effectively.

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with AI tools to enhance coding and debugging processes.
* Experience in mentoring junior engineers and leading project initiatives.
* Knowledge of client-side frameworks would be an additional advantage.

**Why Join**

* Be part of a fast-paced environment where innovation is rewarded and encouraged.
* Engage in significant professional development opportunities and skill enhancement.
* Contribute to projects that directly impact customer experiences and financial accessibility.

If interested please share your resume at
**snehakathar@hirojet.com or apply via link**

description:
**About Precision Autonomy**

We're an insurtech on a mission to enable the safe adoption of autonomous technology. Our end-to-end digital insurance platform serves specialist markets, including aviation and drones, and is already in use across 16 countries in Australia, North America and Europe. We're in a growth stage, scaling the platform and the team behind it, with more exciting developments on the way.

**The role**

We're growing our engineering team in India and looking for mid-level Full Stack Engineers to help build out our platform's capabilities so it meets the current and future needs of our clients. You'll join a small, high-ownership team (currently three engineers, with our Lead based in Delhi), where your work goes straight into production and directly shapes the product.

**What you'll do**

* Build and ship features across the stack, from Angular frontends to Node.js/TypeScript APIs and services
* Own features end to end, from requirements and design through to release and post-release support
* Work closely with product and operations teams to turn business needs into well-scoped technical solutions
* Write well-tested, maintainable code
* Improve performance, observability and automation across the platform
* Help evolve our release process as we move to fortnightly releases, including building out automated testing, safe rollouts and monitoring
* Use agentic AI tooling across design, coding, testing and documentation, and help shape how the team uses it

**Our stack**

Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, AWS, Cypress, CircleCI, TerraForm

**What we're looking for**

* 4+ years of professional software engineering experience
* A track record of shipping production software across both frontend and backend
* Strong TypeScript skills, with experience in Angular (or a similar modern framework) and Node.js
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with MongoDB or other document databases
* Hands-on AWS experience, plus familiarity with CI/CD, automated testing and monitoring tools
* Experience using AI coding assistants or agentic tools in your day-to-day work
* Clear communication with technical and non-technical colleagues across time zones

**Nice to have**

* Start-up or scale-up experience
* Insurance, insurtech or financial services background
* TerraForm experience
* Exposure to aviation, drones, IoT or other autonomous technologies

**On-call**

You'll be part of a shared on-call rotation supporting our US customers outside India business hours, covering critical incidents only.

**What we offer**

* ₹15–22 LPA, depending on experience
* Fully remote within India, with occasional meet-ups for team members in the same city (Bangalore or Delhi preferred)
* Full-time employment through our global employment partner, with statutory benefits
* Individual health insurance
* The chance to join early and help shape both the platform and the engineering culture as the team grows
* A global product used by customers on three continents

**Our process**

Three interview stages, and we move quickly. Apply and we'll be in touch.
